summary: This bill amends the General Education Provisions Act to allow colleges to share student education records with previous institutions to help students earn a postsecondary credential, provided the student gives written consent.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the General Education Provisions Act to allow the release of education records for students to facilitate the award of a recognized postsecondary credential. This directly relates to the administration and efficiency of postsecondary education, but does not involve spending on public schools.
